Deals {2}% of final ATK as additional damage.
■ Activates when entering Full Burst. Affects all allies.

Once: Cooldown of Burst Skill ▼ {3} sec.
Twice: Cooldown of Burst Skill ▼ {4} sec.
Three times: Cooldown of Burst Skill ▼ {5} sec.
